newsitem.title: USA: Baltimore G&E Q4 power sales off on warmth.
newsitem.headline: Baltimore G&E Q4 power sales off on warmth.

text.p: Baltimore Gas and Electric Co said Friday its electric sales declined in the fourth quarter compared to the same period in 1995 due to mild weather conditions.

For the year, the company said, total electric sales increased about one percent reflecting moderate customer growth and a 2.5 percent increase in residential sales. Commercial and industrial sales were relatively flat.
Total natural gas sales in 1996 increased 3 percent compared to 1995 sales levels, Baltimore G&E said.

Sales to residential customers increased by almost 9 percent and commercial sales increased 2.8 percent as a result of customer growth and the cold winter weather experienced in early 1996 which constrasted sharply with 1995's mild winter temperatures.
Industrial sales fell 2.3 percent primarily due to decreased use of natural gas at Bethlehem Steel Corp's Sparrows Point Plant. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
